phase0_baseline_2026-09-09.readiness_signal_confirmed_from_source: Read directly from n8n's own source at the target tag (packages/cli/src/abstract-server.ts, n8n@2.37.11): `/healthz/readiness` returns 200 only when `connectionState.connected && connectionState.migrated && fullyReady`, else 503. `connectionState.migrated` is set true only after `DbConnection.migrate()` (packages/@n8n/db/src/connection/db-connection.ts) completes `dataSource.runMigrations()` without throwing.
